retrievalProfile.description: A tight macro portrait of a face with heavy, overlapping block typography anchored at the top margin.
excludeWhen: modern high-contrast digital photography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up of a human face, focusing on the eyes and bridge of the nose, rendered in soft, warm, grainy tones. The composition is dominated by a massive, ultra-bold sans-serif title that spans the top edge, partially overlapping the forehead area.
coreVisualRelationships: The eyes of the subject align horizontally with the lower third of the image.
The primary title text acts as a heavy header, grounding the top of the frame.
The secondary text is centered directly beneath the primary title in a smaller, contrasting color.
The skin tones and background merge into a singular, warm-hued field.
coreInvariants: Extreme macro cropping of the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is scaled to fill the entire frame, with the eyes positioned centrally and the mouth near the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy, dark purple block lettering at the top serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large top text, moves down to the smaller sub-text, and then settles on the subject's gaze.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is almost entirely occupied by the subject and the graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm brown and tan skin tones (background/subject)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep plum or dark purple (primary typography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on mid-tones and soft shadows; no harsh highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Minimal to zero tracking (letters touching or nearly touching)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Periods or dots are large, circular, and integrated into the baseline of the letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavyweight display font paired with a smaller, high-contrast color version of a similar sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight for the display text.
Offers a vintage, soulful feel with high density.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an extreme macro photograph of a man's face, focusing on the eyes and nose, with a soft-focus vintage film aesthetic and warm brown tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-bold, dark purple sans-serif text at the very top margin with letters nearly touching. Below it, add a single line of smaller cobalt blue sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the face cropped tightly enough to fill the frame?
Is the top text ultra-bold and touching the top edge?
Is the color palette muted and warm?
Is there a visible film grain or soft texture?

adjustableVariables: Specific hue of the purple and blue text
mustRedesign: Do not use modern high-definition digital clarity; maintain the soft 1970s analog look.
Ensure the text is not floating in the middle; it must be anchored to the top.
postGenerationChecks: Check that the eyes are the focal point of the image.
Verify the primary text is the heaviest element in the composition.
Ensure the secondary text is legible but significantly smaller than the primary.
Confirm the color palette remains in the warm/earthy spectrum.
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro portrait + Top-aligned ultra-bold sans-serif + Muted 70s color grade.
